Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 17  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the analysis of the results in Step 17. It incorrectly concluded that Georges Lautner (director of *Le Guignolo*) died earlier than Lesley Selander (director of *Knights of the Range*). However, the facts clearly show that Lesley Selander died on December 5, 1979, while Georges Lautner died on November 22, 2013. The Planner failed to correctly compare the death dates, as 1979 is earlier than 2013. This error led to the incorrect conclusion that Georges Lautner died first, resulting in the wrong solution to the real-world problem.
